affinity.notes: Black, gray, and muted red establish a non-elemental predatory identity.

anatomy.notes: The humanoid torso and arachnid abdomen join cleanly into a coherent creature.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "web-control summoner" semantically communicates Eight-Eye Pattern Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Radiating web strands clearly warn of binding or area-control behavior.

finish.notes: Carapace, webbing, and red eye accents are crisp and consistently integrated.

framing.notes: Symmetric frontal framing exposes the full leg span without meaningful cropping.

identity.notes: Blind perception "humanoid spider matriarch" does not semantically identify exact mapped form arachnids/arachnid-weaver.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is outside the accepted set for intended T3.
